name: Mehdi Hassan Milu
ProgramName: IMATEC - INTERNATIONAL MASTER IN TECHNOLOGY AND MANAGEMENT FOR CIRCULAR ECONOMY
About:
I am Mehdi Hassan Milu, currently pursuing the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Degree in Technology and Management for Circular Economy (IMATEC) as an Erasmus Scholar (2024–26) at the University of Chemistry and Technology (Czech Republic), University of Oviedo (Spain), and Abo Akademi University (Finland). Additionally, I hold the position of Coordinator of the Students and Alumni unit within the Erasmus Mundus Association of Bangladesh (EMA-BD).

I completed my BSc in Chemical Engineering at the University of Debrecen, Hungary, graduating with Excellent distinction. During my undergraduate studies, I was honored to receive the stUD Innovation Fellowship and the MÜZLI Entrepreneurship Scholarship Award for my work on biodegradable plastics and innovation-driven initiatives. Previously, I was also an Officer Cadet (Lieutenant) at the Bangladesh Military Academy and served in the Bangladesh Army for several years.

In my current master’s research, I am working on the synthesis of heterogeneous copper catalysts for direct methane-to-methanol conversion, contributing to sustainable fuel production under a project funded by the Research Council of Finland. My professional experience also includes a summer research internship at the Research Council of Lithuania focusing on metal and radionuclide adsorption by nanoplastics, an industrial engineering R&D internship at COGERSA in Spain working on cyanide determination and wastewater analysis optimization, and advanced technical training at the Rostock Ocean Technology & Maritime Robotics Summer School in Germany on hands-on experience with AUVs, ROVs, and marine sensing systems.

Apart from academics, I contributed as a mentor and an Erasmus buddy with the Stipendium Hungaricum Mentor Network and the Erasmus Student Network (ESN) in Hungary, the Czech Republic, and Finland. I am passionate about investigating natural resources, entrepreneurship, and management for developing and implementing an advanced and brilliant circular economy. To those aspiring to pursue similar opportunities, I encourage you to embrace challenges and uncertainties, as these experiences can shape you into a resilient, well-rounded individual ready to seize future opportunities.

name: Shouvik Roy Snigdha
ProgramName: Erasmus Leader Project
About:
I am currently working as an Administrative Officer at the Office of International Affairs, Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. My responsibilities include managing Erasmus+ international mobility programmes, coordinating visa arrangements, and organizing international academic events. I oversee the entire Erasmus+ exchange process—from application and selection to pre-departure coordination—ensuring a smooth and well-supported experience for students, academic staff, and administrative personnel.

I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering and a Master’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), both obtained from Daffodil International University. My academic and professional journey has been enriched by significant international exposure through the Erasmus+ programme. During 2016–2017, I studied for one academic year at the University of Évora, Portugal, as an Erasmus scholar under the LEADER project, which broadened my academic outlook and intercultural understanding. In 2023, I further strengthened my professional expertise through an Erasmus+ Staff Mobility at the Silesian University of Technology, Poland.

Through my professional responsibilities and international experiences, I have developed a strong passion for fostering global connections and facilitating cross-cultural exchange. I am committed to supporting students, faculty, and staff in their internationalisation journeys and to promoting educational enrichment while building sustainable global partnerships for Daffodil International University.
